item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00283","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C14","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.72,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C18 plausibly supplied a material geographic-designation template: statutory and public-interest recitals lead to a presidential proclamation designating a precisely bounded marine area, followed by operative administrative implementation. The child adapts that machinery to restricted Great Lakes pilotage districts and likewise defines waters through navigational landmarks, bearings, and coordinates. C14 and C03 also use proclamation-based designation of precisely described territories, but their monument-land context and operative machinery are less closely aligned.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"acting under and do hereby designate and proclaim the following areas","parent_excerpt":"acting under and by virtue of the authority vested in me ... do proclaim that ... the following-described area is designated as the Key Largo Coral Reef Preserve","explanation":"Both use an authority clause followed by an operative presidential designation of a geographically defined area."},{"child_excerpt":"All United States waters ... a line ... running (at approximately 127° true) between Carruthers Point Light and South Side Light","parent_excerpt":"BEGINNING at a point on the 80-foot depth curve ... 200 yards southeast of Flashing White Light—Whistle Buoy \"2\"; thence northwesterly ...","explanation":"Both delimit marine areas through navigational lights or buoys, bearings or directions, distances, and other hydrographic reference points."},{"child_excerpt":"on and after the effective date of regulations issued by the Secretary of Commerce pursuant to the Act","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior is requested to prescribe rules and regulations governing the protection and conservation ... in this area","explanation":"Each couples the presidential geographic designation with subsequent departmental regulations governing the designated waters."}]}
